crossRefs.note: It came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice, and said to him…
But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”
“The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers…
“Then he will answer them, saying, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you didn’t do it to one of the least of these…
Then Jesus said to them, “Don’t be afraid. Go tell my brothers that they should go into Galilee, and there they will…
You are my friends, if you do whatever I command you.
No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for…
Jesus said to her, “Don’t hold me, for I haven’t yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am…
Therefore we know no one after the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now we know…
I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,’ says the Lord Almighty.”
For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call…
Those in the good ground, these are those who with an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it tightly…
Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven; but he who does the will of my Father…
While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying…
They said therefore to him, “What must we do, that we may work the works of God?”
Jesus answered them, “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”
If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.
But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.
If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.
so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his…
This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he…
Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t…

parallels.note: But he answered him who spoke to him, “Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?”

translations.web: But he answered them, “My mother and my brothers are these who hear the word of God, and do it.”
translations.bsb: But He replied, “My mother and brothers are those who hear the word of God and carry it out.”
translations.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of God, and do it.
translations.asv: But he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these that hear the word of God, and do it.
